analog_architecture.authority: Owns selected circuit blocks, typed connections, analog control fields and per-block resource allocations. Existing behavioral cases and physical_services retain their evidence scope; the current design is not automatically simulated by legacy fixtures.
analog_architecture.model_reconciliation: Selected electrical compositions resolve current ownership and converter parameters from the architecture inventory. Independent common-node fixtures remain explicit sensitivity scenarios, not conservative bounds. Joined control, clock, pad and payload evidence is still required for whole-chip qualification.

packaging_gate.required: Preserve current golden-mask bond positions and provider power/ground assignments. Use the real seal ring and all four required ID/marker cells at template locations; pass official COB geometry checks before declaring the foundation packaging-compatible. Complete upstream precheck, electrical ring checks and board/bond verification before tapeout.
packaging_gate.ground_topology: Pinned COB design ties all ten die ground sites to the same board GND; separate on-chip analog return routing does not imply independent off-chip grounds.
packaging_gate.power_topology: PCB supply names are not proof of independent die rails. Preserve native power sites and verify on-chip joins before assigning external voltages.
packaging_gate.wire_geometry: Pinned Run 1 published rules: no crossing, angle <=45deg, actual wire length <3mm and >=max(1mm,2*die thickness), bonding area without solder mask. Confirm selected-run applicability and actual landing/loop geometry. Current centered straight-line projection is not wire-length qualification.
packaging_gate.current_status: Selected packaging assembly passes pinned upstream size, mask and test-ID insertion checks. Horizontal pad placements now retain half-micron arithmetic; real PDK seal ring and provider ID cells are included. Full upstream precheck, final assigned ID, electrical continuity and physical signoff remain pending.

assumptions: Continuous bit packing across word boundaries; per-source static slots, no payload packet headers.
Five header words per 64-word frame protect metadata; payload has no CRC/quarantine. V2 RTL is default, legacy v1 is a compile-time comparison. Acquisition is word-aligned only.
100 ppm independent host/source bounds are provisional budgeting margins, not a PCIe SSC model.
FIFO depth, service gaps, CDC, clock tracking, pad timing and analog performance require separate evidence.
Pass 2 models lossless source-matched playout and explicit per-frame valid-word counts; it does not prove CDC, error recovery, arbitrary drift or FIFO sufficiency for all phases.
The finite phase/frequency queue model is retained explicitly for legacy v1; v2 has integrated nominal-clock tests but no equivalent drift/phase bound yet.

tx_amplitude_operating_requirement.mitigation: Digital backoff consumes output power and effective converter resolution. Existing generic analog gain may be used only after its range/noise/current/settling are represented. No extra PA, pin or buffer is selected.
tx_amplitude_operating_requirement.owner: FPGA scales and rounds signed I/Q before transport; chip does not silently normalize or add protocol profiles.
tx_amplitude_operating_requirement.scope: Bound applies to the entire retained reconstruction waveform, including overshoot and previous held codes. Prove from bounded code history or evaluate the intended waveform with a conservative interpolation/tail margin. It is not an RMS or per-component limit.

tx_port_power_goal.scope: Constant-envelope and wideband goal, assessed with actual waveform crest factor, quality and emissions; not a range guarantee. No external PA assumed.

host_output.acceptance: Both HOST banks within existing ceilings under arbitrary legal traffic, plus FPGA capture eye, package/source-return transient, ringing, overshoot and narrow operating-range verification.
host_output.board_requirement: Short low-capacitance point-to-point connection to suitable FPGA. Generic GPIO compatibility does not guarantee full rate at arbitrary board load.
host_output.definition: External lumped load per D2H data/clock pin including FPGA input, board and connector contribution; die pad capacitance must be accounted separately exactly once after library load convention is resolved.
host_output.drive_selection: Programmable strength/slew; choose a common setting from matched timing and energy under actual load, not independent minima. No stock-cell implementation selected.
host_output.legacy_scope: Existing 10 pF package waveforms remain heavy-load controls; no silent substitution of 6 pF into their evidence.

multi_chip_video.electrical: DC current-sink differential TX; RX 50 ohm per leg to 3.3 V, disabled for AC serial modes; source/sink and voltage tolerance unqualified

sar_timing.bit_decision_owner: local completion sequencer; no external LO edge required after acquisition
sar_timing.budget_owner: Existing CORE converter/control allocation; no new reference pin or independent fixed-rate sampling oscillator. Physical sequencer delay, current and variability remain unqualified. Repartition the same25ns nominal cycle:3ns acquisition,20ns maximum conversion,2ns reset plus the separate0.2ns uncertainty guard. Each bit reserves0.7ns comparator time; DAC settling intervals are unchanged. This is a timing allocation, not measured settling or comparator performance.
sar_timing.deadline_failure: Late or missing completion must not become a valid word or overlap the next acquisition; busy/timeout detection and reset are implementation obligations.
sar_timing.in_flight_lo_loss: Finish a launched conversion only while local supply/reference remain valid. Missing LO prevents subsequent acquisition edges; fault/STOP epoch rules determine whether a completed word may be delivered.

startup.initial_charge: Explicit discharged reference, sample and DAC state after rails are valid; startup recharge is part of the existing reference allocation.
startup.model_qualification_scope: Assigned coarse 1 V reference/bias window and2.5..3.6V supply model domain, not an ENOB guarantee, process absolute maximum or measured sensor specification. Both lower and upper supply limits gate readiness and transport. Observe quiet bias recovery, acquisition reference and actual comparator-decision reference values. Maintain the existing 20 us guard over held valid observations after START/latest invalid-to-valid transition. During active conversion, normal modeled charge-step excursions are accounted for in settling, charge balance and code accuracy; they do not alone reset bias qualification. Reference collapse or invalid consumption-point reference/supply prevents valid word admission. Physical sensing accuracy, timing, independent thresholds and budget remain open.
startup.payload_admission: Require clock presence, valid local supply and reference/bias qualification as well as the startup guard. Timer expiration alone is insufficient; analog sensing or a justified worst-case settling bound remains to be implemented.
startup.readiness_epoch: Start the qualification interval no earlier than actual reference-bias enable. Discharging or reinitializing the reference invalidates prior readiness and requires a fresh qualification interval.
startup.scope: The 20 us guard is the existing behavioral allocation, not a measured settling bound. No new protocol profile or external pin; bias-enable observability, analog thresholds, sequencer and budget realization remain physical implementation obligations.
startup.warm_stop: Payload STOP need not discharge the reference. The selected warm recovery model retains analog charge and prescribed bias/clock activity; power-saving STOP is not qualified.

shared_pad_isolation.acceptance: Reject if inactive loading, leakage or clamp conduction violates any selected active mode. Isolation sizing must satisfy both fast-mode loading and enabled-branch resistance/settling; application-specific external coupling and pullups are allowed.
shared_pad_isolation.inactive_loads: Include every disconnected branch's residual per-leg and mutual admittance plus protection. Disabled enable does not imply zero capacitance or absence of clamp conduction. Qualify powered, reset and unpowered external drive.
shared_pad_isolation.model: SharedWiredPad accepts off_branches_f mapping branch names to P/N capacitances, replacing aggregate off_cap_f. Optional rail_clamp and ground_clamp tuples specify threshold drop and resistance; they remain active with functional branches isolated and account for rail backfeed and dissipation. Missing clamps mean omitted/unqualified protection, not fail-safe proof. The affine standalone step rejects these nonlinear configurations; the coupled ODE uses their electrical currents. This does not qualify actual protection or GHz package behavior.
shared_pad_isolation.power_off_topology: RX and TX pad primary protection is referenced to ground; branch-local secondary rail clamps require power-off-tolerant isolation. No diode path to a collapsed WIRE_VDD may conduct at normal external USB/TMDS levels. Ground-referenced protection must remain inactive throughout the selected signal envelope while protecting internal devices; its trigger window and capacitance are unqualified.
shared_pad_isolation.topology: Branch-local isolation: serial RX bypasses the TMDS divider; USB isolates the divider and serial termination. TX detection injection, serial drive and TMDS drive have mutually exclusive ownership. Independent USB pulls/termination/sensing remain available within prevalidated electrical states.
